items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: I played at the country club with Percy. ... Well I played with his band ... You say you played with Percy Humphrey then a while too? Yeah, yeah. I used to play up at Dastry and Percy Humphrey.

ctx.x: But you probably have played with a lot of other bands.

Oh yeah, like, uh, played with, uh, Jack Carey and, uh, Frankie Dewson, and played with, uh, Willie Alpey, not Willie, Earl. Earl, the job one way. No, no, the trumpet player was, Percy. Percy. Percy, yeah, yeah, Percy.
